 GTA VI Is Making GTA V Sell More Copies This Month
 By Can Torcu November 17, 2026 
 Grand Theft Auto 
 Share 
 Twitter 
 Facebook 
 Bluesky 
 Pinterest 
 Reddit 
 WhatsApp 
 Threads 
 Email 
 Copy Link 
 GTA V continues to sell millions of copies even after more than a decade since its original release. With GTA VI getting closer, many players are already looking forward to the next entry in the series. However, Rockstar’s previous game is still attracting a huge number of players across different platforms and GTA VI is a big reason for that.
 According to Take-Two Interactive’s latest figures , GTA V has sold 235 million copies worldwide. The game also sold another 5 million copies during the last quarter alone. Its total revenue has now passed $10 billion.
 But its sales numbers are not the only impressive part. New estimates from Alinea Analytics show that GTA V continues to attract millions of players every month. Between November 1 and November 13, GTA V sold an estimated 150,000 additional copies across PlayStation, Steam, and Xbox. PlayStation accounted for the largest share with 54.2% of sales. Steam followed with 25.2%, while Xbox made up the remaining 20.6%.
 The game also gained around 85,000 new players through PlayStation Plus during the same period. This shows that GTA V is still finding new audiences, even years after its release.
 GTA V Reaches 16 Million Monthly Active Players
 According to the same estimates, GTA V had around 16 million monthly active users across all three platforms in November. PlayStation made up the largest part of this player base with 77.3%. Xbox followed with 12.8%, while Steam accounted for 9.8%.
 Alinea Analytics also shared some interesting data about the other games GTA V players have been playing recently. Of the nearly 13 million PlayStation and Xbox players who played GTA V over the past 22 days, 36% also played Fortnite during November. Roblox came second with 25%, followed by Rocket League at 10%. FC 27 and Call of Duty both accounted for 9% of these players.
 With GTA VI expected to arrive next week, it will be interesting to see how these numbers change. Many players could soon move their attention to Rockstar’s upcoming game. However, GTA V’s latest figures show that its popularity is far from over.
